metadata.case_name: YEUNG YUK KEE v. KONG TSING BOR

injuries.description: The proximal phalanx (i.e. the bone of the finger nearest the hand) of each finger of the plaintiff's right hand was fractured.
injuries.body_part: right hand (proximal phalanges of each finger)
source: The proximal phalanx (i.e. the bone of the finger nearest the hand) of each finger of the plaintiff's right hand was fractured.

injuries.description: A 1" wound on the index finger was also repaired.
source: A 1" wound on the index finger was also repaired.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of finger or thumb, unspecified

injuries.description: the plaintiff has stiffness of all 3 joints of all 4 fingers. Her fingers cannot be straightened or clenched into a full grip.
source: the plaintiff has stiffness of all 3 joints of all 4 fingers. Her fingers cannot be straightened or clenched into a full grip.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple flexor muscles or tendons at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: hand remained painful and swollen for a month or two
stiffness of all 3 joints of all 4 fingers
fingers cannot be straightened or clenched into a full grip
she still had pain ... to ease the pain she was still suffering after the K-wires were removed

treatments_received: operation and fractures fixed by K-wire
repair of 1" wound on the index finger
consultation with a bonesetter (from 2nd May to 2nd December, 1975)
treatments_future: regular and persistent physiotherapy over a period of 6 months (recommended by Dr. Fu)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities.
